يخرنطم (form IIIq)
# يَخْرَنْطِمُ (yaḵranṭimu) /jax.ran.tˤi.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْرَنْطَمَ (iḵranṭama)
# يُخْرَنْطَمُ (yuḵranṭamu) /jux.ran.tˤa.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْرَنْطَمَ (iḵranṭama)
# يَخْرَنْطِمَ (yaḵranṭima) /jax.ran.tˤi.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْر
